summary: theme::fonts() and font_tests were reverified unchanged (the font code is byte-identical to the integrated revision and its tests are green), and docs/architecture/ui.md now documents the native Segoe UI registration with the bundled per-glyph fallback and corrects the page-layout wording to the implemented vertical flow and viewport-edge clipping.

THEME-NATIVE-SYSTEM-FONT.evidence: Reverified unchanged in this execution: the font code (fonts, compose_fonts, native_ui_font_bytes, font_tests) has no differing hunks between this branch and agent/integration (the theme.rs delta there is T12's comments and retired slider tokens), and the re-run font_tests (3) plus theme tests (20) are green. The composition still starts from FontDefinitions::default(), registers the native Windows face as `segoe-ui` at the head of the proportional family when %WINDIR%\Fonts\segoeui.ttf is readable, keeps the bundled default_fonts list in order behind it as the per-glyph fallback, and returns the bundled set untouched when the file is missing; the live-context test shows glyph advances matching a native-only context, so the native face is what lays out text.

DOCS-ARCHITECTURE-ALIGNMENT.evidence: docs/architecture/ui.md now states the implemented facts in both required places. Layout: the header and the action bar sit outside the one scroll owner in the page's vertical flow, separated from the body by theme::SECTION_GAP, both keep the card chrome inset by theme::PAGE_PADDING, the body reserves the action bar's full frame (theme::SECTION_GAP plus ACTION_BAR_HEIGHT), and the body clips its content at its own viewport edge (a scrolled card is clipped there rather than sliding behind the bars) - matching app.rs page()/body(), where header/body/actions_bar are siblings of one vertical ui with item_spacing.y = SECTION_GAP, the body's ScrollArea max_height is available_height minus (SECTION_GAP + ACTION_BAR_HEIGHT), and the ScrollArea owns the clipping. Typography: the paragraph documents that theme::fonts() registers the native Windows UI face (Segoe UI from %WINDIR%\Fonts\segoeui.ttf) at the head of FontFamily::Proportional with the bundled default_fonts faces behind it as per-glyph fallback, that call sites keep the generic families, and that bold emphasis remains theme::stamp_galley's approximation until a weighted family has call sites - matching theme.rs and font_tests. git diff agent/integration -- docs/architecture/ui.md is exactly those two corrected paragraphs.

risks: The window's ctx.set_fonts(theme::fonts()) wiring is T13's current-wave app.rs work and is outside this task's owned files; the typography contract documents the theme-side ownership, and the running-window acceptance belongs to that task.
